# Title

## Section

Before publishing a guide, check that **each step** tells the reader what to do and where to do it. Use *italics* for a term the reader will see again, and put a command such as `git status` in inline code. Read the draft from top to bottom to check that the steps follow the order in which the reader will perform them. Verify any command examples against the [docs](https://example.com/docs).

- Review the headings.
    - Check that each heading describes its content.

- Read the paragraph aloud.

1. Check the commands.

2. Review the links.
    - Open each link and confirm its destination.

> A clear example gives the reader a starting point.
